summary: Per-vehicle telemetry packet encoder (__thiscall on the vehicle struct, output buffer a2). Writes a header marker with the current session time, then packs physics/state fields from the vehicle struct into a bitfield DWORD array via a series of encoding subroutines: position vector, speed, fixed-point and short conversions, per-wheel suspension position + offset sums, RPM, throttle, gear, clutch, per-index subsystem-ready bits, and a packed flag word (driver-model visibility, brake threshold, and other flag bytes). Final flag word also mirrors the player vehicle's state dword, then the packet is closed by a trailing encoding call.

operations.description: Initialize loop index v2 to 0 and load the session-time double dbl_8AFEA0 into the float argument v21.
Call ProgressBarEventEncode(a2, 1, 0, 52, *(this+18580), v21, 0) to write a header/progress marker into the packet buffer using the vehicle's state dword at +0x4894 and the session-time value.
Set v4 = a2 + 2, the pointer to the packet body words following the header.
Call sub_4B2310(a2 + 2, this + 1860, this + 1796) to encode a position/offset vector pair from the vehicle struct into the packet body.
Call UtilityFunction_2480((_WORD*)a2 + 4, this + 13560) to encode a float field into a 16-bit short field of the packet.
Call FloatToFixedConversionWithClamp(a2 + 2, this + 13584) to convert a float into clamped fixed-point in the packet body.
Call FloatToShortClampedConversion((_WORD*)a2 + 4, this + 13632) to encode a float into a clamped 16-bit short.

do-while loop over 4 wheel entries (v2 from 0 to < 1184 in steps of 296): computes v22 = *(float*)(v2 + this + 1776 + 332) + *(float*)(this + 1852), i.e. per-wheel suspension position (stride 0x128) plus the body offset field +0x73C, then calls FloatToByteShortEncoding(v4, v24, v22, *v23) where v23 advances from this + 13756 (field +0x35BC) by stride 62 each iteration; increments v24 as the wheel index.
Call FloatToBitfieldPack(v4, *(this + 14752)) to pack the engine RPM float (field +0x39A0) into a bitfield slot.
Call BitfieldInsert(v4, *(this + 13692)) to insert the throttle factor float (field +0x357C) into a specific bitfield position.
Call ShortComputation_2a10(v4, *(this + 14844)) to encode the current-gear DWORD (field +0x39FC) into the packet.
Conditionally set or clear bit 0x80 in packet word v4[11] based on flag byte at this + 4201 (field +0x1069).
Call FloatToBitfieldEncoder(v4, *(this + 13696)) to encode the clutch-engagement float (field +0x3580) into a bitfield with shift/mask.
for i in 0..13: v8 = SubsystemReadyQuery(i); BitfieldSetClearByIndex(v4, i, v8) - queries 14 subsystem-ready booleans and sets/clears the corresponding bit by index in the packet.
Conditionally set or clear bit 0x8000000 in packet word v4[12] based on flag byte at this + 4189 (field +0x105D, driver-model visibility).
Conditionally set or clear bit 0x4000000 in packet word v4[12] based on the brake-factor float at this + 13700 (field +0x3584) compared to 0.0099999998.
Conditionally set or clear bit 0x2000000 in packet word v4[12] based on flag byte at this + 4199 (field +0x1067).
Conditionally set or clear bit 0x80000000 in packet word v4[12] based on flag byte at this + 13388 (field +0x344C).
Conditionally set or clear bit 0x1000000 in packet word v4[12] based on flag byte at this + 16420 (field +0x4024).
Call FunctionCallWrapper_2b10(v4, *(this + 16424)) to encode the steering float (field +0x4028) into the packet.

Call BitfieldSetter(v4, *(dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC] + 18580)) to set a packet bitfield from the player vehicle's state dword at +0x4894, resolved through the vehicle pointer array global and the current-player-index global.
Call Constant5(this) to obtain the final encoding value v19.
Return sub_4B2AE0(v4, v19), the final packet closing/encoding call.
Called by PitTimingUpdate (0x004B7A90) and TireTemperatureSimStep (0x004C77D0) to emit the per-vehicle telemetry packet.

unresolved: The exact bit assignments of packet words v4[11] and v4[12] beyond the visible masks (0x80, 0x8000000, 0x4000000, 0x2000000, 0x80000000, 0x1000000) are only partially decoded; the remaining bits are owned by other writers.
SubsystemReadyQuery index semantics for i in 0..13 are not decoded here; the mapping of index to subsystem lives in 0x004E18C0.
The layout of the packet header written by ProgressBarEventEncode and the trailing sub_4B2AE0 close are callee-internal.
Encoding transforms applied by each packing subroutine are callee-internal.
